// Fixture for tests/unit/analyzers/js-test-cases.test.ts: read as `src/ui/panel.test.tsx`.
// Kept as .txt so the test runner never collects it.
import { describe, it, test, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from "vitest";
import { render } from "@testing-library/react";
import { Panel } from "./Panel";
import { loadLayers, ModelLoader } from "../core/loader";

const LAYERS = loadLayers("fixture");

function renderPanel(title: string) {
  return render(<Panel title={title} />);
}

function test2(a: number) {
  return a * 2;
}

describe("ModelLoader", () => {
  let loader: ModelLoader;

  beforeEach(() => {
    loader = new ModelLoader(LAYERS);
  });

  it("loads every layer", async () => {
    const model = await loader.load();
    expect(model.layers).toHaveLength(13);
  });

  it.skip(`skips the ${"slow"} path`, () => {
    loader.reload();
  });

  describe("when the cache is warm", () => {
    test.only("reuses the cache", () => {
      expect(loader.cached()).toBe(true);
    });

    it.each([
      ["a", 1],
      ["b", 2],
    ])("maps %s to %d", (name, n) => {
      expect(loader.index(name)).toBe(n);
    });
  });
});

describe.each([[1], [2]])("table %i", (n) => {
  test.each`
    a    | b
    ${1} | ${2}
  `("adds $a and $b", ({ a, b }) => {
    expect(a + b + n).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

test("renders the panel", { timeout: 1000 }, () => {
  const { getByText } = renderPanel("Hello");
  expect(getByText("Hello")).toBeTruthy();
});

const NAME = "dynamic";
it(NAME, () => expect(test2(2)).toBe(4));

it("loads every layer", () => {
  expect(loadLayers("again")).toBeTruthy();
});

it.todo("handles a corrupt manifest");
test("no callback");

test.describe("Playwright suite", () => {
  test("logs in", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/login");
  });
});

afterAll(() => {
  LAYERS.length = 0;
});
